facility.name: Tiger's Den Martial Arts & Fitness
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: During this inspection, there was no documentation of the annual certification of recalled children's products issued by the CPSC.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During an evaluation of six staff files, two caregiver files did not contain proof of completion of required annual training in preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations. One caregiver file did not contain proof of required annual training in handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2025 Survey data from January 17, 2026, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2025 by January 15, 2026, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The following observations were made:  - a broken toilet in the boy's restroom - an inoperable sink in the boy's restroom - a broken fence board
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver was missing 2 of the 24 required annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have documentation of the monthly fire drills, carbon monoxide, smoke detector test and fire extinguisher checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During inspection, caregivers in charge did not have access to all records during director's absence from center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: During inspection, emergency drills were locked in a room only accessible to Director. Director was not present at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Homework: During inspection, seven children were observed on their personal devices such as phones and tablets playing vide games and watching videos.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Homework (26 TAC §746.2207(d))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: Operation last validated their people list on 3/12/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: During inspection, children records were locked in a room only accessible to Director. Director was not present at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: During inspection, transportation binder did not have medical emergency information for children who are being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: During inspection, staff personnel and trainings were locked in a room only accessible to Director. Director was not present at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Staff hired on 5/28/2007, 5/16/2022, 5/20/2024, 4/27/2008, 10/18/2023, 2/18/2013, 10/4/2017, and 5/4/2019 did not have proof of education in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor: Staff hired on 10/18/2023 and 5/20/2024 did not have pre employment affidavit in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor (26 TAC §HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regar)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported the number of employees who left employment as required by January 15, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: During follow up, two volunteers hired on 9/28/2023 were observed supervising children in care without an initial background checks submission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: During follow up, classroom was observed watching cartoons that was not related to a planned activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During follow up, Director did not ensure that all minimum standard requirements are being met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During follow up, two volunteers hired on 9/28/2023 were observed supervising children in care without an initial background checks submission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: During follow up, two volunteer that was present during inspection did not have a personnel or training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Staff hired on 6/5/2023 did not have notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: Director had not completed 30 hours of annual training for 2022-2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Staff hired on 10/4/2017, 5/4/2019 had not completed 20 hours of their annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: Volunteer that was present during inspection did not have a personnel or training file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During inspection, five children did not have emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Staff hired on 6/5/2023 did not have proof of education on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Staff hired on 6/5/2023 did not have documentation showing they received operational and personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills had not been conducted for the 2023 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: Staff hired on 2/16/2015, 5/4/2019, 10/4/2017, 6/5/2023 did not have current transportation training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: Fire extinguisher inspections had not been conducted by director for year 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Director did not have record of their time sheets avaliable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Classroom was observed watching a movie that was not related to a planned activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: During inspection two volunteers were observed in contact with children without a background check. One of the volunteers was observed counted in ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Director did not ensure that all minimum standard requirements are being met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Staff hired on 4/5/2019, 9/6/2018, 1/6/2021, 10/4/2017, 1/30/2019, 8/20/2021, 2/16/2015 and 2/6/2020 have 12 hours of annual training for 2021-2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: Director had 26 hours of annual training for 2021-2022 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))
